mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 4.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 115), the economy is expanding, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 115 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A high CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 205) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 205 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a weakening labor market and reduced consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises and RSAFS falls (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Positive real GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0) indicates a strengthening economy, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is in a tightening cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
